_about: Answer key for node scripts/qa-oddities.mjs --eval: before/after pictures from past Canada fix PRs (#495-#518), labelled by an agent that had not seen Jev's answers (2026-11-22). Each key is <review-pages folder>/pics/<file>; scripts/oddities/eval-set.mjs fetches them. Add new bugs here as they are found, with the frame the bug was seen in.

neb636--bath-polish/pics/clean-after.jpg.scene: Misty's Bubble Bath close-up: clean cream spirit bear Misty waist-deep in the pool before a curling shader waterfall with foam; the folded pink towel under her paw; Maple at the left edge; prompt 'Now the towel!'

neb636--bath-polish/pics/clean-before.jp.scene: Bath close-up (old look): clean cream Misty with a sun-bear chest crescent in front of a flat pale waterfall of white bars; a pill-shaped lavender towel under her paw; Maple at the left edge.

neb636--bath-polish/pics/mirror-after.jp.scene: Mirror close-up: Misty with a dyed lilac curly hairdo, pink flower and gold crown beams at the camera, waterfall behind; letterboxed with the 'Is that me?' line.

neb636--bath-polish/pics/suds-after.jpg.scene: Bath wide play view (new look): mud-splattered Misty standing in the pool with soft foam on her chest and rainbow soap bubbles at her face; Maple on the bank, pink unicorn rubber duck, soap on a rock, raven on a branch, smiling rain cloud, pink sponge tool at the bottom.

neb636--bath-polish/pics/suds-before.jpg.scene: Bath play view (old look): smudgy muddy Misty holding the pink sponge with black-outlined ball bubbles; Maple on a rock, box-shaped pool, flat waterfall of white bars, rain cloud, raven.

neb636--bath-polish/pics/tall-after.jpg.scene: Bath in portrait: muddy Misty and Maple standing in the pool before the curling waterfall, rubber duck floating, sponge tool at the bottom, rain cloud and raven above.

neb636--bath-polish/pics/wash-after.jpg.scene: Bath play view (new look): mud-splattered Misty in the rounded pool with ripple rings at her legs, Maple on the bank, unicorn duck, soap on a rock, sponge tool, curling waterfall.

neb636--bath-polish/pics/wash-before.jpg.scene: Bath play view (old look): smudgy muddy Misty in a box-shaped pool, Maple on the bank, soap on a rock, sponge tool, flat white-bar waterfall.

neb636--bath-polish/pics/wide-before.jpg.scene: Wide bath view (old look): muddy Misty in a rectangular blue pool under a boxy pale waterfall, Maple on a rock, mossy boulders, cone-ish trunks, sponge tool, rain.
neb636--bath-polish/pics/wide-before.jpg.unsure: The old waterfall is a hard-edged, pale, see-through box (0.36-0.67 x, 0.4-0.62 y); reads as the flat art style the fix replaced rather than a transparency bug.

Crop of the bath's front edge (old berries): three bushes of plain dot berries, Maple and pink-foamed Misty in the pool, duck; an iPad dock is visible below the game.

oddities.note: Maple's hockey stick: the pink blade floats beside the top of the shaft instead of joining it

neb636--bath-rainforest-fixes/pics/splas.unsure: The old splash is a solid white blob column that Misty overlaps (0.33-0.6 x, 0-1 y); it reads as crude art more than a transparency or clipping bug.
